serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: LCPtracker Pro is delivered as a SaaS offering using a multi-tenant Public Cloud cloud computing environment. It is available to public commercial enterprises, federal, state, local, and tribal governments, as well as research institutions, federal contractors, and government contractors. LCPtracker Pro is a cloud-based prevailing wage and workforce compliance management solution. The application is ideal for public agencies and prime contractors that are responsible for keeping all contractors on their project, even down to the lower-tier subcontractors, compliant. Additionally, clients can track detailed worker information and leverage dynamic reporting to monitor workforce initiatives.
